THE TRUMP ORGANIZATION
July 11, 2011
To whom it may concern:
For the past three years, I have enjoyed a daily working relationship with Michael Bocci°, having trusted him with many of my personal and business endeavors, in his capacity of Managing Director of Business Development and Special Counsel.
Michael was a person that I would call into my office and could always count on for a smart point of view. Michael is as comfortable in a boardroom negotiating critical business points as he is drafting a complex legal document. He naturally assumed a leadership role in any task that I assigned to him. He has prospered under my mentorship
and I relied on him as an asset to every area of my business.
I highly recommend Michael for employment or consideration as a partner in any business venture. He will make any company or individual that may be lucky enough to work alongside him more effective, efficient and profitable.
incerely Donald Trump 725 FIFTH AVENUE • NEW YORK, NY 10022 •
